title: Data Scientist
description: Transform complex enterprise data into strategic predictive models, statistical insights, experimental designs, and automated business decisions.

goal.objective: Extract predictive value and actionable intelligence from complex corporate datasets using statistical inference and applied machine learning.

learn.summary: Master exploratory data analysis, hypothesis testing, regression/classification, ensemble methods (XGBoost/LightGBM), A/B testing methodology, and storytelling.
key_competencies: A/B Test Design, Sample Sizing & Power Analysis

capstone_projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction & Lifetime Value Forecaster
capstone_projects.description: Build an end-to-end customer churn prediction engine featuring feature attribution (SHAP values) and an executive scenario planner.

capstone_projects.title: End-to-End Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) Forecasting System
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an end-to-end regression and survival analysis model to forecast customer LTV, containerized with FastAPI and logged via MLflow with automated drift detection.

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate
interview_focus: Hypothesis Testing (Type I / Type II Errors, Statistical Power)
Interpreting SHAP Values for Business Stakeholders

stages.title: Python, Math, and Data Analysis Fundamentals

topics.name: Python Programming Fundamentals for Data Science
topics.description: Master Python syntax, data structures (lists, tuples, dicts, sets), control flow, functions, error handling, and object-oriented programming concepts essential for data manipulation and analysis.

resources.title: Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]

topics.name: Data Manipulation with Pandas & NumPy
topics.description: Learn advanced data structures (DataFrames, Series), indexing, filtering, grouping, merging, pivoting, reshaping data, and vectorized operations for efficient numerical computation in Python. Understand data cleaning basics like handling missing values and duplicates.

resources.title: Python for Data Science - Course for Beginners (Learn Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib) (freeCodeCamp.org)
Data Analysis with Python - Full Course for Beginners (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn) (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: SQL and Database Fundamentals
topics.description: Master SQL for querying, filtering, joining, and aggregating data from relational databases. Understand common database concepts like tables, keys, and basic schema design. Practice extracting data for analysis using various SQL commands.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Core Statistics and Probability for Data Science
topics.description: Understand descriptive statistics (measures of central tendency, dispersion), probability theory (random variables, distributions like Normal, Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson), inferential statistics (sampling, Central Limit Theorem, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing - t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-squared), A/B testing principles, and correlation vs. causation.

resources.title: Complete Statistics for Data Science (Krish Naik)
Statistics for Data Science | Probability and Statistics | Statistics Tutorial | Ph.D. (Stanford) (Great Learning)

topics.name: Exploratory Data Analysis and Visualization
topics.description: Perform comprehensive data profiling, univariate, bivariate, and multivariate analysis. Master advanced data cleaning (outliers detection and treatment, inconsistent data, type conversion), feature understanding, and effective data visualization using Matplotlib and Seaborn for uncovering patterns, relationships, and anomalies. Document findings and generate actionable insights through compelling plots and reports.

resources.title: Exploratory Data Analysis in Pandas | Python Pandas Tutorials (Alex The Analyst)
Data Analysis with Python - Full Course for Beginners (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn) (freeCodeCamp.org)

project.title: UCI Machine Learning Repository Data Story
project.description: Analyze a public dataset, clean it, perform thorough EDA, visualize key patterns, and publish a short notebook with insightful business recommendations.

stages.description: Establish an unshakeable foundation in Python for scientific computing, vectorized numerical manipulation (NumPy/Pandas/Polars), and data cleaning pipelines.

stages.title: Machine Learning Core Concepts and Applications

topics.name: Data Preprocessing and Foundational Feature Engineering
topics.description: Prepare data for machine learning models: handle categorical variables (one-hot, label encoding), numerical scaling (standardization, normalization), manage imbalanced datasets (oversampling, undersampling, SMOTE), split data into training, validation, and test sets. Understand feature scaling importance and basic feature transformation.

resources.title: Data Cleaning in Pandas | Python Pandas Tutorials (Alex The Analyst)
Feature Engineering for AI: Transforming Raw Data into Predictions (IBM Technology)

topics.name: Supervised Learning: Regression and Classification Models
topics.description: Deep dive into fundamental supervised algorithms: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Trees, and Support Vector Machines (SVMs). Understand model training, regularization (L1, L2), and the bias-variance tradeoff. Learn about ensemble methods like Random Forests, Bagging, Boosting, and Gradient Boosting Machines (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost).

resources.title: Machine Learning for Everybody – Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Model Evaluation, Validation, and Hyperparameter Tuning
topics.description: Master essential evaluation metrics for classification (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, confusion matrix) and regression (MAE, MSE, RMSE, R-squared, Adjusted R-squared). Understand cross-validation techniques (k-fold, stratified), hold-out sets, data leakage, and hyperparameter tuning strategies (Grid Search, Random Search, Bayesian Optimization intro).

resources.title: How to evaluate ML models | Evaluation metrics for machine learning (AssemblyAI)
Machine Learning Tutorial Python - 16: Hyper parameter Tuning (GridSearchCV) (codebasics)

topics.name: Unsupervised Learning and Dimensionality Reduction
topics.description: Explore clustering algorithms (K-Means, DBSCAN, Hierarchical Clustering, Gaussian Mixture Models) for grouping data. Understand dimensionality reduction techniques (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, LDA) for visualization and feature extraction. Learn about anomaly detection algorithms (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM) and similarity search concepts.

resources.title: Machine Learning Tutorial Python - 13: K Means Clustering Algorithm (codebasics)

project.title: Advanced Prediction Model Notebook
project.description: Build and compare multiple models (baseline and advanced), document preprocessing steps, evaluate models fairly using appropriate metrics and cross-validation, and write detailed recommendations based on model performance and insights.

stages.description: Master rigorous mathematical statistics, probability distributions, hypothesis testing methodologies, and A/B test experimental design.

stages.title: Feature Engineering, Deep Learning, and Specialized AI

topics.name: Advanced Feature Engineering and Selection
topics.description: Develop expertise in creating meaningful features from raw data: numeric transformations (polynomial, interaction terms, Fourier transforms), advanced categorical encoding (target encoding, frequency encoding, leave-one-out encoding), date/time features (cyclical features, time differences), text-based features (TF-IDF, word embeddings overview), and geographical features. Implement robust feature selection methods (filter, wrapper, embedded methods, RFE) to improve model performance and interpretability.

resources.title: Feature Selection Techniques Easily Explained | Machine Learning (Krish Naik)

topics.name: Deep Learning Fundamentals with TensorFlow/PyTorch
topics.description: Grasp the core concepts of artificial neural networks (ANNs), activation functions, loss functions, optimizers, and regularization (dropout, batch normalization). Learn about backpropagation, gradient descent variants, and the architecture of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). Introduce Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image data and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for sequential data. Understand practical aspects like data loading, transfer learning, and GPU utilization using frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch.

resources.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning & Machine Learning – Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Introduction to Natural Language Processing (NLP)
topics.description: Learn fundamentals of NLP including text preprocessing (tokenization, stemming, lemmatization), text representation (Bag-of-Words, TF-IDF), sentiment analysis, topic modeling (LDA), and an introduction to word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe) and transformer models (BERT, GPT basics).

resources.title: What is NLP (Natural Language Processing)? (IBM Technology)
Natural Language Processing with spaCy & Python - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Introduction to Computer Vision (CV)
topics.description: Explore core concepts of Computer Vision: image preprocessing, feature detection (edge, corner), object recognition, and image classification. Understand basic architectures like CNNs for image tasks, transfer learning with pre-trained models (e.g., ResNet, VGG), and practical applications.

resources.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision with Python and TensorFlow – Complete Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
What is Computer Vision? | Introduction (First Principles of Computer Vision)

topics.name: Responsible AI, Ethics, and Explainability (XAI)
topics.description: Address crucial aspects of AI ethics: fairness (bias detection, mitigation strategies, fairness metrics), privacy (differential privacy, federated learning concepts), and transparency. Learn about model interpretability techniques such as LIME, SHAP, Permutation Feature Importance, and Partial Dependence Plots to understand 'why' models make predictions. Discuss ethical considerations, societal impact, and governance of AI systems.

project.title: Explainable and Fair ML Report
project.description: Train a model, explain top drivers using XAI tools, test subgroup performance for fairness, and write a non-technical model risk summary for stakeholders.

stages.description: Design, train, and validate supervised and unsupervised machine learning models, gradient boosted trees, and ensemble architectures.

stages.title: MLOps, Data Storytelling, and Capstone Project

topics.name: MLOps: Deployment, Monitoring, and Orchestration
topics.description: Implement MLOps best practices: experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases), data versioning (DVC), model versioning and registries. Learn model deployment strategies (API endpoints with Flask/FastAPI, containerization with Docker, serverless functions, cloud services like AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP AI Platform). Understand continuous integration/delivery (CI/CD) for ML, model monitoring (data drift, concept drift, performance decay), and automated model retraining strategies. Introduce workflow orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, Kubeflow).

resources.title: MLOps Course – Build Machine Learning Production Grade Projects (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Data Storytelling, Business Communication, and Visualization Design
topics.description: Transform complex analytical findings into compelling narratives tailored for business impact. Master principles of effective data visualization (choosing appropriate chart types, clear labeling, avoiding misleading visuals). Learn to tailor communication for diverse technical and non-technical audiences, present actionable insights, articulate assumptions and limitations, and guide stakeholders towards data-driven decisions. Practice presenting findings through interactive dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Streamlit) and professional reports.

resources.title: Data Storytelling Basics (in 3 Steps): How to Communicate Data and Numbers (Word Cortex with Anita)
12 Dashboard design tips for better data visualization (Geckoboard)

topics.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End MLOps Application
topics.description: Design, develop, and deploy a complete machine learning project from problem definition to production. This includes rigorous dataset acquisition/creation, comprehensive EDA, advanced feature engineering, model selection, robust evaluation, interpretability analysis, containerized deployment (e.g., using Docker and a web framework like Flask/FastAPI or Streamlit), experiment tracking, CI/CD pipeline integration, and a clear, professional README, technical documentation, and a final presentation.

resources.title: Deploy ML models with FastAPI, Docker, and Heroku | Tutorial (AssemblyAI)
MLOps Course – Build Machine Learning Production Grade Projects (freeCodeCamp.org)

project.title: Deployed ML Demo with MLOps Practices
project.description: Create a simple model API or Streamlit app, deploy it, integrate with tracked experiments (e.g., MLflow), write a clean README, and provide a short project write-up detailing the end-to-end process and MLOps considerations.

stages.description: Deploy predictive models into production via containerized REST microservices with automated model performance drift monitoring.

Data Analysis with Python - Full Course for Beginners (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn) (freeCodeCamp.org)

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

Statistics for Data Science | Probability and Statistics | Statistics Tutorial | Ph.D. (Stanford) (Great Learning)

resources.title: Data Cleaning in Pandas | Python Pandas Tutorials (Alex The Analyst)

resources.title: How to evaluate ML models | Evaluation metrics for machine learning (AssemblyAI)
Machine Learning Tutorial Python - 16: Hyper parameter Tuning (GridSearchCV) (codebasics)

resources.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning & Machine Learning – Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

What is Computer Vision? | Introduction (First Principles of Computer Vision)
